name: 受取時間帯と表示数を添えた食事の提供枠
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Generate ONE compact Japanese Lighthouse pickup availability row LH19-0012, landscape composition, pure white canvas with modest margins.
HIERARCHY: Image1 ORIGINAL Too Good To Go source has highest authority for original outline right-chevron geometry, optical stroke/proportions, alignment, spacing and small details. Only target source Surprise Bags row, not address/map/prices/nav. Image2 original circular beverage photo and overlapping yellow badge crop is protected artwork: preserve the two glass milk-tea bottles, straws, tabletop, actual crop/colors, circular shape and overlap badge position. Exactly ONE pale-yellow circle badge with 「3」, no duplicate baked-in3. Image3 Japanese mock SECONDARY content/layout guide; improve any rough chevron using source. Image4 approved Lighthouse style only: white rounded surface/fine neutral outline/soft shadow.
Exact Japanese component content: heading 「この食堂で受け取れる食事」; below one row with original circular photo on left, ONE overlapping pale yellow badge3 on its lower-right edge, text column 「ライトハウス食堂」 bold body and 「明日 12:00〜12:15」 regular body; precise slate-outline right chevron at trailing edge.
Typography locked Meiryo headingBold20/28, bodyRegular14/24 (existing eatery name weight remains bold), metadata12/16, tracking0. Preserve compact mock wrapping and all wording/numerals. Main ink #1D1D1D, supporting icons #526173, white card/canvas. Retain original pale yellow count badge (#FFF9B3 approximately) and dark forest numeral as purposeful availability-count emphasis with actual numeral, not random decorative accent. No other accent or new green CTA. No price, address, map, live-stock claims, time picker or invented control. Softly elevated rounded white card, fine neutral border; keep concise layout, no huge blank region, clipping, gloss or watermark.
reviewNotes: 原本・写真と重なりバッジの切抜き・日本語モック・独立編集を実見。日本語の見出し／食堂名／明日12:00〜12:15、単一の黄色3、原写真の2瓶と重なり位置、原本優先のchevronを確認。淡黄色を表示数の意味色として保持し補助chevronはスレート、不要な主要ボタンは追加せず。白面・控えめな影、欠けなし。数字3は実在庫の証明ではない。画素とフォント数値一致・所有者承認・編集可能性・動作は未認定。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
